name: Perplexity
summary: Perplexity is a company in San Francisco that makes an AI answer engine and the Comet browser. It was [founded in August 2022](https://techcrunch.com/2024/01/04/ai-powered-search-engine-perplexity-ai-now-valued-at-520m-raises-70m/).

incidents.title: Amazon Sues Perplexity Over the Comet Shopping Agent
incidents.summary: Amazon sued Perplexity in November 2025. It alleges that the Comet browser's AI agent accessed password-protected Amazon accounts without identifying itself as an AI agent. A district court granted a preliminary injunction in March 2026, and an appeals court vacated it in August 2026.
incidents.description: Amazon alleges that the AI agent in Perplexity's Comet browser accessed users' password-protected Amazon accounts, at the users' direction, without identifying itself as an AI agent. [Amazon says](https://www.cooley.com/news/insight/2026/2026-08-06-ninth-circuit-rules-on-ai-agent-access-to-third-party-websites-under-cfaa) this broke federal and California computer-fraud laws. A district court granted a preliminary injunction, but the [Ninth Circuit vacated it](https://cdn.ca9.uscourts.gov/datastore/opinions/2026/08/04/26-1444.pdf) and held that the user, not Perplexity, accessed Amazon's computers.

incidents.title: Prompt-Injection Flaws Found in Perplexity's Comet Browser
incidents.summary: Brave researchers reported that Perplexity's Comet browser could follow hidden instructions in web pages. In a demonstration, this exposed a user's email address and one-time password. Perplexity said it fixed the issue before anyone noticed.
incidents.description: [Brave researchers reported](https://brave.com/blog/comet-prompt-injection/) that the AI assistant in Perplexity's Comet browser followed hidden instructions on web pages. In a demonstration, these instructions made the assistant send a user's email address and one-time password to an attacker. [Perplexity said](https://decrypt.co/336763/perplexity-comet-flaw-exposed-user-data-attackers-brave-reports) that it fixed the issue, but Brave said the fix was not complete.

timeline.title: Brave reports the flaw
timeline.description: Brave reports the indirect prompt-injection flaw to Perplexity.

timeline.title: Brave discloses the flaw
timeline.description: Brave publishes its findings and says the fix is not complete.

timeline.title: Brave reports screenshot prompt injection
timeline.description: Brave reports that instructions hidden in screenshots can also control Comet's assistant.
